about: A directed graph laid out by rank: focus a node to trace what feeds it and what it feeds, and open or close a branch with the count of what it hides.

controlled.about: The caller keeps the focus in its own state through focus and onFocusChange, so a search result, a table row or the address can focus a node. A press on a node or the Clear focus control reports the new focus back.
controlled.label: Order lineage
controlled.title: Controlled focus

empty.about: A graph without a node renders its message in the canvas's place, at the canvas's ratio, without the controls, the readout or the overview.
empty.label: Revenue lineage
empty.title: Empty

isolate.about: trace="isolate" renders the focused node and the nodes it traced alone, laid out again, and depth={1} follows one hop each way. A warehouse graph runs to thousands of tables, and one hop is enough for most questions.
isolate.label: Revenue lineage, one hop
isolate.title: Isolated trace

lineage.about: The graph opens focused on dim_customer. Each card that feeds it or depends on it states its relation, and the rest recede. Select another node to trace it, and press Escape or Clear focus to drop the trace. The layout moves only when the nodes shown change.
lineage.caption: Customer dimensions feed the executive overview and the churn features, and the failed events model feeds both.
lineage.label: Revenue lineage
lineage.title: Lineage

org.about: treeEdges turns a flat list whose people state their manager into the chart's edges. collapsible gives each manager a control with the number of people it hides or shows, and trace="off" keeps a focus as a selection.
org.description: Press Enter or Space to select the person, and Escape to clear the selection.
org.label: Organisation chart
org.prompt: Select a person to see how many people report to them.
org.title: Org chart

title: Directed graph

words.description: Press Enter or Space to trace the dataset, and Escape to clear the trace.
words.prompt: Select a dataset to trace what feeds it and what depends on it.
